meta.tagline: The PNW startup pitch competition directory

events.name: Demolicious Monthly Pitch
events.description: Portland's monthly pitch event reintroduced in 2024 by UpStart Collective. Founders get 3 minutes to pitch, audience votes for the winner. Monthly champion advances to an annual Championship Showdown.
events.notes: 2026 is the final year of the monthly format. Remaining monthly events: September 17 and October 15 at UpStart Collective (Big Pink), plus a November date, then the 2026 Champion of Champions in December at Mission Theater, Portland (date TBD). Starting January 2027 Demolicious becomes an annual event rather than monthly. October 15 RSVP is open via Luma; sign up to pitch through their website.

events.name: Westside Pitch
events.description: Pitch competition for Washington County, OR entrepreneurs. Offers equity investment, cash prizes, and professional services to tech and traded-sector startups.
events.notes: 2026 cycle completed April 23 in Hillsboro. Monitor for 2027 cycle — applications typically open early winter.

events.name: TiE Pitch Club
events.description: Monthly mock investor meeting where entrepreneurs present pitches and receive real-time feedback from TiE Oregon angel investors. Includes Q&A sessions with experienced investors, written peer and investor feedback, and a digital copy of your pitch. Focused on skill-building and refining pitches — no competition prize.
events.notes: Ongoing monthly program. Next event held at CENTRL Office Pearl on November 18, 2026 at 5:30pm. Requires TiE Oregon membership. Contact Kari.Naone@oregon.tie.org or register through the TiE Oregon events page.

events.name: TiE Women Global Pitch Competition
events.description: Global pitch competition dedicated to empowering women entrepreneurs. The PNW regional winner advances to compete globally for equity-free prize money. Open to female-founded or co-founded businesses (minimum 33% female equity) registered after January 1, 2019 and actively seeking funding.
events.notes: Application deadline was June 30, 2026 (now closed). TiE Oregon Regional Pitch Competition: August 12, 2026 (preceded by workshops July 22, 29, and August 5). Chapter Mentoring & Finals: June 26–Aug 31; Semi-finals NA/Europe: September 17–18 (TiE Los Angeles); Semi-finals Asia: September 24–26 (TiE Hyderabad); Grand Finale: December 14–15, 2026 at TiE Global Summit in Indore, India. Over $100,000 in equity-free prizes; top winner receives $50,000.

events.name: TiE U Regional Pitch Competition
events.description: Entrepreneurship program for Oregon-based university students with a regional pitch competition and global competition opportunity at the TiE Global Summit. Teams of 2–7 members with at least 2 current students or recent graduates (within 24 months). Includes mentorship from successful Oregon business leaders and access to TiE's global network.
events.notes: 2025–2026 regional pitch completed April 4, 2026; that cohort's global competition is December 2026 at TiE Global Summit in Silicon Valley. 2026–2027 cycle announced: registration opens November 2, 2026, application deadline January 17, 2027. Regional Pitch Competition: April 3, 2027. Global competition: December 2027 at TiE Global Summit.

events.name: Pitch Polish Bootcamp Competition
events.description: Four-day investment-readiness bootcamp hosted by the OSU Advantage Accelerator at Oregon State University in collaboration with TiE Oregon, culminating in a live Final Pitch Day. Top finalists pitch on stage to investors and local executives, competing for an investment check from TiE Oregon Angels plus in-kind service awards.
events.notes: Final Pitch Day: November 20, 2026, 10:00 AM at Austin Hall, Oregon State University, Corvallis, OR. Registration open now. Additional bootcamp details to be announced.

events.name: Pitch Please
events.description: Monthly pitch event where founders get 5 minutes to pitch virtually or in person. Regional thought leaders ask questions and give feedback.
events.notes: Runs monthly. September 15, 2026 session completed and its registration is now closed. Next session October 20th on Zoom — check the OEN events calendar for the confirmed date and registration link.

events.name: Angel Oregon Technology
events.description: 5-week intensive program for early-stage technology founders culminating in a live Pitch Day in front of active investors.
events.notes: Cohort 1 Pitch Day completed April 7. Cohort 2 registration has closed ahead of the original October 20 deadline. Pitch Day is October 20, 2026 (hybrid, in-person preferred). Investment decisions for Cohort 2 announced August 2027.

events.name: Angel Oregon CPG
events.description: 5-week capital and funding literacy program for early-stage consumer packaged goods founders (food, beverage, personal care, wellness, lifestyle, and pet products) in Oregon and SW Washington. Virtual curriculum covers funding strategies, valuations, cap tables, and due diligence, culminating in a live Pitch Day in front of investors and community partners.
events.notes: Cohort 1 Pitch Day completed April 8. Cohort 2 registration has closed ahead of the original October 21 deadline. Pitch Day is October 21, 2026. Investment eligibility finalized and announced in June 2027.

events.name: Angel Oregon BIO
events.description: 5-week intensive program for early-stage life science and bioscience founders culminating in a live Pitch Day in front of active investors. Investment announced in December 2026.
events.notes: Cohort 1 Pitch Day completed April 9. Cohort 2 registration has closed ahead of the original October 22 deadline. Pitch Day is October 22, 2026. Investment decision announced December 2026.

events.name: Pop Up & Pitch
events.description: Marketplace pitch events for Oregon food and beverage entrepreneurs, co-hosted with partners like Burgerville.
events.notes: Typically held spring/summer. Monitor OEN calendar.

events.name: InventOR Collegiate Challenge
events.description: Oregon's only statewide collegiate prototyping competition. Student teams receive $2,000 development grants and compete for $30,000 in prizes at the annual June finals.
events.notes: 2026 finals completed June 26 at OSU-Cascades, Bend, OR. 2027 event page is live with 'tickets coming soon' — specific date not yet announced. Monitor for details.

events.name: PSU Cleantech Challenge
events.description: 10-week program for PSU student teams focused on cleantech innovation, pairing mentorship and prototyping funds with design thinking, business modeling, and market research. Culminates in a live pitch competition and prototype exhibition at the Finals before six finalist teams. Top team advances to the statewide InventOR competition.
events.notes: 2026 Finals completed April 1, 2026 ($6,000 total awarded: 1st $1,500, 2nd $1,000, 3rd $500, plus PGE Foundation Impact Award grand prize $2,000). 2026–27 application cycle listed as 'coming soon' on pdx.edu — no dates announced yet. Monitor for details.

events.name: OBI Pitch Events
events.description: Oregon's life sciences incubator occasionally hosts pitch and demo events for biotech and health-focused startups. Also a past venue for Founders Live PDX.
events.notes: OBI Annual Startup Spotlight Expo (September 17, 2026) has concluded and is no longer listed on the homepage. No other pitch/demo event currently announced — upcoming items are non-pitch networking events (Accelerate Biotech Happy Hours Nov 5 & Dec 3). Monitor otradi.org/otradi-events/ for the next pitch or demo event.

events.name: 45Camp Accelerator
events.description: VertueLab's accelerator program supporting early-stage cleantech startups with mentorship, curriculum, connections, and pitch-based funding opportunities.
events.notes: Program page (vertuelab.org/45-camp) returns 404 as of July 2026; homepage no longer lists 45Camp. Possible discontinuation. May remove listing if status remains inactive.

events.name: Opalene Climate Challenge
events.description: Investment program pooling philanthropic capital (via donor-advised funds and impact-investing partner Realize Impact) to make direct investments in early-stage Washington clean technology companies, with a focus on climate resilience, climate mitigation, and historically underrepresented founders. Finalists present to a Selection Committee.
events.notes: Applications closed August 24, 2026. Screening/due diligence Aug 4–Sept 2; finalists notified Sept 18. Celebration event with finalist presentations: October 1, 2026. Investment disbursement October 2026. Multiple investments of $100,000 or more (pre-seed to Series A, clean tech sectors: energy, mobility, built environment, agriculture, industrial). Monitor for next cycle after this round concludes.

events.name: Cascadia CleanTech Accelerator
events.description: 18-week virtual accelerator for pre-seed cleantech startups in the Northwest. Includes mentorship, curriculum, and pitch-based funding competition. Program runs May–September annually.
events.notes: No active cycle found; website shows 2024 content only. Monitor for future announcements.

events.name: Oregon Startup Week
events.description: Week-long celebration of the statewide startup community including pitch events, workshops, and networking. Includes the annual Demolicious Startup Week edition.
events.notes: Rebranded from Portland Startup Week to Oregon Startup Week; portlandstartupweek.com now redirects to oregonstartupweek.com. May 11–16, 2026 event completed (4,000+ attendees). Next: Oregon Startup Week 2027, May 10–15, 2027 at Big Pink, Portland. Submissions for events open the first week of November 2026.

events.name: Founders Live Portland
events.description: Monthly happy-hour pitch competition where 5 founders each give a 99-second pitch followed by 4 minutes of audience Q&A. Audience votes determine the winner.
events.notes: Last event June 25, 2026 at White Owl Social Club, Portland. No upcoming Portland events currently listed. Monitor founderslive.com for next Portland date. Apply to pitch at founderslive.com/pitch.

events.name: Founders Live Seattle
events.description: Monthly happy-hour pitch competition where 5 founders each give a 99-second pitch followed by audience Q&A. Audience votes determine the winner. Seattle is the birthplace of Founders Live.
events.notes: Next event September 24, 2026, 6–9 PM at thinkspace, 1700 Westlake Avenue North, Seattle. Also scheduled: October 29, 2026, 6–9 PM (venue TBA). Apply to pitch at founderslive.com/pitch.

events.name: Gorge PitchFest 2026
events.description: Annual pitch competition hosted by the Mid-Columbia Innovation Hub serving entrepreneurs in the Columbia River Gorge region on both the Oregon and Washington sides.
events.notes: 2026 event completed May 28 at The Granada Theatre, The Dalles. Monitor for 2027 cycle.

events.name: Beaverton Startup Challenge
events.description: Annual funding competition operated by the Oregon Startup Center in partnership with the City of Beaverton and the Westside Startup Fund. Open to scalable startups across tech, consumer products, manufacturing, bio/life sciences, and cleantech. Winners receive a SAFE note investment (historically ~$20k), 6 months of mentorship, and a Demo Day showcase.
events.notes: 2025 Demo Day completed May 13 at the Patricia Reser Center for the Arts. Applications typically open Q1 annually. Monitor for 2027 cycle.

events.name: Impact Pitch Competition
events.description: Annual multi-round pitch competition open to small businesses in Alaska, Idaho, Oregon, and Washington. Focuses on community impact alongside business viability. Three categories: Startup/Idea Stage, Early Stage, and Established. Note: tech companies and apps are not eligible.
events.notes: Round 1 closed June 1. Round 2 closed June 30 (results July 15). Round 3 submissions due August 10; coach meetings July 20–24. Introduction video submissions due September 8. Live pitch event October 1, 2026. $46,000 total in prizes (five $1,000 Community Impact Awards, ten $1,000 Finalist Grants, one $1,000 Audience Voting Award, three $10,000 Grand Prizes).

events.name: Venture Community
events.description: Oregon's original reverse road show event bringing together 12 leading PNW funds and 26 Oregon startups for 2 days.
events.notes: Last event was in 2018.

events.name: PIE Demo Day
events.description: One of Portland's most established startup incubators, co-founded by Wieden+Kennedy. Has hosted demo days and pitch events for cohorts since 2009.
events.notes: All PIE programs listed as 'on hiatus for 2026' on their website. Worth monitoring for a return.

events.name: Dempsey Startup Competition
events.description: One of the Pacific Northwest's premier collegiate startup competitions, open to students at accredited colleges across the Cascadia Corridor (WA, OR, ID, BC, AK). Teams develop business plans and pitch to investors across multiple elimination rounds.
events.notes: 2026 competition rounds completed through May 21, 2026. 2027 cycle announced: application site opens late February, due April 5 by 11:59pm. Screening Round April 8–13. Investment Round May 6. Sweet Sixteen & Final Round May 27, 2027.

events.name: SCORE Washington Women's Pitch Contest
events.description: Annual pitch competition for women entrepreneurs in Washington, Alaska, and Northern Idaho. Focused on helping women-led businesses secure loan financing. Finalists pitch directly to bank and financial institution loan officers.
events.notes: 2026 competition concluded. Winners announced April 2, 2026. Recognition event May 6, 2026 at Washington Small Business Awards Gala. Check back October 2026 for next cycle.

events.name: SCORE Tech Entrepreneurs Pitch Contest
events.description: Annual pitch competition for Washington-based tech entrepreneurs at any stage. Participants work with SCORE mentors to develop pitch decks, then compete in front of judges for cash prizes and mentorship.
events.notes: Applications closed May 30, 2026. Contest event: September 16, 2026. Monitor for 2027 cycle.

events.name: TAO AI Startup Innovation Sandbox
events.description: Live pitch competition showcasing early-stage AI startups with Pacific Northwest roots. Features an investor reverse pitch panel, a live startup pitch competition with investor voting, and networking with founders, investors, and regional innovation leaders.
events.notes: April 22, 2026 event completed. Monitor techoregon.org for next cycle.

events.name: Startup World Cup Portland Regional
events.description: Inaugural Portland regional of the global Startup World Cup, organized in partnership with Oregon Entrepreneurs Network, Upstart Collective, and Business Oregon's Oregon Innovation Showcase. Ten finalist startups each give a 4-minute pitch and 2-minute Q&A before an investor panel. The regional winner advances to the global finale competing for $1,000,000.
events.notes: 2026 event completed May 13–14 at Upstart Collective, 111 SW 5th Ave, Portland. Monitor for 2027 cycle.

events.name: Pitch Night: Curry County
events.description: Annual pitch competition hosted by the South Coast Development Council serving entrepreneurs in Coos, Curry, and Douglas Counties. Focuses on priority sectors including outdoor recreation, digital services, advanced manufacturing, value-added agriculture, clean energy, marine/coastal industries, and forestry innovation.
events.notes: 2026 event completed June 12 at Mr. Ed's, Port Orford. Prizes: 1st $6,500 / 2nd $2,000 / 3rd $1,200 / 4th–5th $650 each + audience choice. Monitor for 2027 cycle.

events.name: BVC Pitch Contest
events.description: Presented by Economic Development for Central Oregon (EDCO), billed as the largest angel conference in the Pacific Northwest. Startups pitch across three tracks — Growth Tech, Growth Industries, and Early Stage — to attendees including angel investors. Investment opportunities are not guaranteed by the contest itself; finalists pitch to attendees who may choose to invest independently.
events.notes: 2026 applications closed August 13. Ten Early Stage semifinalists were announced September 15, 2026; they pitch September 24 at Central Oregon PubTalk: Road to BVC at Worthy Brewing's outdoor stage in Bend, where the audience also awards one Early Stage company $5,000 (courtesy of Washington Trust Bank) and votes on who advances. Growth Tech and Growth Industries finalists are announced in early October. Conference and finals: October 15–16, 2026 at the Tower Theatre, downtown Bend. At least $40,000 in cash goes to a Central Oregon–headquartered startup. Applicants must be U.S.-based C-corps with an open funding round Sept–Nov 2026.

aggregators.name: Calagator
aggregators.description: Portland's community tech calendar. A great first stop for spotting new pitch and startup events.

aggregators.name: Silicon Forest
aggregators.description: Portland's best local startup news source — excellent coverage of pitch events, demo days, and ecosystem news.

aggregators.name: Technology Association of Oregon (TAO)
aggregators.description: Oregon's leading tech industry association. Check their calendar for pitch and innovation events.
